title: Finish Matching on Rebuilt Units — Finishing Shop
content:
Exterior color openings on the window contract set the finish-matching days. For Factory Production Orders, finish matching adds business days to the rebuild of a customer specification remake by the openings priced on the exterior color change orders of the window contract the order builds:

- openings numbering at least half of the units on the order add **3 business days**;
- at least one opening but fewer than half adds **2 business days**;
- no such opening adds nothing.

The days form part of the remake lead, counted in whole business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) from the rebuild start date; the end of that lead is the remake revised ship date.

## Where the openings are found

The Window Replacement Contracts records of the contract the order builds: change orders of the kind exterior color, the openings each prices summed across all of them, compared with the units on the factory order.

## Threshold on both sides (hypothetical)

| Units on the order | Exterior color openings | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 3 | 3 |
| 6 | 2 | 2 |
| 5 | 3 | 3 |
| 5 | 2 | 2 |
| 6 | 0 | none |
